why: Determine whether confirmed external 1000 USDT add-to-existing position later actually sent Dragon to router, buyer or other wallet; do NOT infer sell or PnL from mere outbound transfer.
on_more_than_10_records: Do not claim window exhaustive; mark CENSORED and make separate new precommit for scoped next page if needed. Do not select which trades to keep by result.
if_unsupported: Record unsupported and stop; do not label no exits.
if_true_outgoing: All returned transfers are candidates only. A transferred token may be gift, internal move, LP deposit or router sale. Later independently freeze signature, receipt, quote-token reimbursement and actual BNB/native/USDT balance checks.
if_empty: Only source-specific scoped no outgoing ERC20 movements; cannot prove wallet did not swap via another contract mechanism, did not hold other assets, or never exits later.
also_require: No public follower observation timestamp; original owner trade preceding does not imply causal follow.
